excerpt.id: Pendampingan lengkap pengurusan izin kerja dan tinggal Tenaga Kerja Asing (TKA) di Indonesia, mulai dari RPTKA hingga ITAS.
excerpt.en: Complete assistance for processing work and stay permits for Foreign Workers (TKA) in Indonesia, from RPTKA to ITAS.

penjelasan_umum: Jika Anda berencana merekrut Tenaga Kerja Asing (TKA) di Indonesia, memastikan seluruh perizinan berjalan sesuai ketentuan adalah hal yang krusial. Melalui layanan Perizinan Tenaga Kerja Asing Baru, kami siap memberikan pendampingan mulai dari penyusunan Rencana Penggunaan Tenaga Kerja Asing (RPTKA) hingga pengurusan Izin Tinggal Terbatas (ITAS).

Proses pengajuan izin ini membutuhkan tenaga ahli yang memahami regulasi dan kebijakan terkini mengenai penggunaan TKA di Indonesia. Dengan dukungan tim profesional berpengalaman, setiap tahapan—mulai dari persiapan dokumen hingga penerbitan izin—dapat diselesaikan secara legal, aman, dan sesuai peraturan yang berlaku. Hal ini memastikan seluruh administrasi terkait izin tenaga kerja asing berjalan lebih efisien dan tepat sasaran.

Sebagai penyedia layanan yang menekankan aspek legalitas serta kepatuhan hukum, kami memahami bahwa pengurusan izin TKA melibatkan berbagai tahap penting: pembuatan dokumen, proses verifikasi, persetujuan instansi pemerintah, hingga penerbitan izin akhir. Dengan mempercayakan proses ini kepada kami, Anda dapat menghindari kendala administratif serta memastikan bahwa tenaga kerja asing dapat bekerja secara resmi tanpa hambatan.
Layanan kami dirancang untuk memberikan solusi lengkap, profesional, dan terpercaya bagi perusahaan maupun individu yang memerlukan pendampingan dalam pengurusan Izin Tenaga Kerja Asing Baru.

penjelasan_umum: If you plan to recruit Foreign Workers (TKA) in Indonesia, ensuring that all licensing proceeds in accordance with the provisions is crucial. Through our New Foreign Worker Licensing service, we are ready to provide assistance from the preparation of the Foreign Manpower Utilization Plan (RPTKA) through to processing the Limited Stay Permit (ITAS).

This permit application process requires experts who understand the latest regulations and policies regarding the employment of foreign workers in Indonesia. With the support of an experienced professional team, every stage—from document preparation to permit issuance—can be completed legally, safely, and in accordance with applicable regulations. This ensures that all administration related to foreign worker permits runs more efficiently and precisely.

As a service provider that emphasizes legality and legal compliance, we understand that processing foreign worker permits involves several important stages: document preparation, verification process, government agency approval, through to the issuance of the final permit. By entrusting this process to us, you can avoid administrative obstacles and ensure that foreign workers can work officially without hindrance.
Our service is designed to provide a complete, professional, and trusted solution for companies and individuals requiring assistance in processing a New Foreign Worker Permit.

penjelasan_umum: 若您计划在印度尼西亚招聘外籍劳工（TKA），确保所有许可依规办理至关重要。通过我们的新外籍劳工许可服务，我们随时准备从外籍劳工使用计划（RPTKA）的编制到临时居留许可（ITAS）的办理提供全程协助。
此许可申请流程需要了解印度尼西亚外籍劳工雇佣最新法规及政策的专业人员。在经验丰富的专业团队支持下，从文件准备到许可签发的每个阶段都能够合法、安全且依规完成。这确保了与外籍劳工许可相关的所有行政事务运作得更加高效精准。
作为强调合法性及法律合规的服务提供商，我们深知外籍劳工许可的办理涉及多个重要阶段：文件制作、核实流程、政府机构批准，直至最终许可的签发。将此流程托付给我们，您可避免行政障碍，并确保外籍劳工能够正式工作，畅通无阻。
我们的服务旨在为需要办理新外籍劳工许可协助的企业及个人，提供全面、专业且值得信赖的解决方案。

This permit application process requires experts who understand the latest regulations and policies regarding the extension of foreign worker employment in Indonesia. With the support of an experienced professional team, every stage—from document preparation to permit issuance—can be completed legally, safely, and in accordance with applicable regulations. This ensures that all administration related to foreign worker permits runs more efficiently and precisely.

As a service provider that emphasizes legality and legal compliance, we understand that processing the extension of foreign worker permits involves several important stages: document preparation, verification process, government agency approval, biometric data and photo capture at the Immigration Office, through to the issuance of the final permit. By entrusting this process to us, you can avoid administrative obstacles and ensure that foreign workers can work officially without hindrance.
Our service is designed to provide a complete, professional, and trusted solution for companies and individuals requiring assistance in processing a Foreign Worker Permit Extension.

excerpt.id: Izin Tinggal Terbatas bagi warga negara asing lanjut usia (lansia) yang bermaksud menetap di Indonesia.
excerpt.en: Limited Stay Permit for elderly foreign citizens intending to reside in Indonesia.
excerpt.zh: 为有意在印度尼西亚定居的外国老年公民提供的临时居留许可。

penjelasan_umum: Jika Anda berusia 55 tahun atau lebih dan berencana untuk tinggal dan menetap di Indonesia. Melalui layanan Perizinan Tinggal Terbatas untuk Lansia, kami siap memberikan pendampingan pelayanan untuk Izin Tinggal Terbatas Lansia.

Proses pengajuan izin ini membutuhkan tenaga ahli yang memahami regulasi dan kebijakan terkini mengenai orang asing yang berusia lansia dan berencana untuk tinggal dan menetap di Indonesia. Dengan dukungan tim profesional berpengalaman, setiap tahapan mulai dari persiapan dokumen hingga penerbitan izin dapat diselesaikan secara legal, aman, dan sesuai peraturan yang berlaku. Hal ini memastikan seluruh administrasi terkait izin tinggal lansia berjalan lebih efisien dan tepat sasaran.

Sebagai penyedia layanan yang menekankan aspek legalitas serta kepatuhan hukum, kami memahami bahwa pengurusan izin tinggal lansia melibatkan berbagai tahap penting: pembuatan dokumen, proses verifikasi, persetujuan instansi pemerintah, hingga penerbitan izin akhir. Dengan mempercayayakan proses ini kepada kami, Anda dapat menghindari kendala administratif serta memastikan bahwa warga negara asing lansia dapat tinggal di Indonesia secara resmi tanpa hambatan.
Layanan kami dirancang untuk memberikan solusi lengkap, profesional, dan terpercaya bagi perusahaan maupun individu yang memerlukan pendampingan dalam pengurusan Izin Tinggal Terbatas Lansia

penjelasan_umum: If you are 55 years of age or older and plan to reside and settle in Indonesia, through our Elderly Limited Stay Licensing service, we are ready to provide assistance for the Elderly Limited Stay Permit.

This permit application process requires experts who understand the latest regulations and policies regarding elderly foreigners planning to reside and settle in Indonesia. With the support of an experienced professional team, every stage from document preparation to permit issuance can be completed legally, safely, and in accordance with applicable regulations. This ensures that all administration related to elderly stay permits runs more efficiently and precisely.

As a service provider that emphasizes legality and legal compliance, we understand that processing elderly stay permits involves several important stages: document preparation, verification process, government agency approval, through to the issuance of the final permit. By entrusting this process to us, you can avoid administrative obstacles and ensure that elderly foreign citizens can reside in Indonesia officially without hindrance.
Our service is designed to provide a complete, professional, and trusted solution for companies and individuals requiring assistance in processing the Elderly Limited Stay Permit.
